# Force field

Turns a mesh (best a sphere or capsule) into a translucent energy shield: a glowing rim, a hexagon lattice that lights up toward the edges, and ripples that spread from a hit. Set `hitPoint` (in object space) and `hitTime = effect.time` to trigger one. Given the scene’s depth, it also draws a bright line where it cuts through other objects.

<EffectDemo effect="force-field" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { forceField } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/force-field';

const effect = forceField({ preset: 'shield' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  effect.tick(clock.getDelta());
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#4cc9ff'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter           | Type                                                      | Default     | Range                | Description                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `color`             | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#4cc9ff'` |                      | Shield color.                                                                                                                        |
| `intensity`         | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0 – 8                | Overall brightness, in linear units.                                                                                                 |
| `rimPower`          | number                                                    | `2.5`       | 0.5 – 8              | Width of the rim: higher values hug the silhouette.                                                                                  |
| `fill`              | number                                                    | `0.05`      | 0 – 1                | Glow across the whole shell.                                                                                                         |
| `hexScale`          | number                                                    | `10`        | 1 – 60               | Number of hexagons around the shell.                                                                                                 |
| `hexIntensity`      | number                                                    | `1`         | 0 – 4                | Brightness of the hexagon lattice.                                                                                                   |
| `hitPoint`          | [x, y, z]                                                 | `[0, 0, 1]` | -100 – 100           | Where the last hit landed, in object space.                                                                                          |
| `hitTime`           | number                                                    | `-10`       | -1000000 – 1000000 s | When the last hit landed, on the effect’s clock: set it to `effect.time`.                                                            |
| `rippleSpeed`       | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0.1 – 10 units/s     | How fast ripples spread.                                                                                                             |
| `rippleStrength`    | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0 – 5                | Brightness of ripples.                                                                                                               |
| `sceneDepth`        | 2D texture                                                | `null`      |                      | A depth texture of the scene without the shield, from the same camera (for example from a depth prepass), for the intersection line. |
| `cameraNear`        | number                                                    | `0.1`       | 0.0001 – 100         | Intersection: the camera’s near plane.                                                                                               |
| `cameraFar`         | number                                                    | `100`       | 1 – 100000           | Intersection: the camera’s far plane.                                                                                                |
| `intersectionWidth` | number                                                    | `0.15`      | 0.01 – 2 scene units | Width of the intersection line.                                                                                                      |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                 |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `shield`  | `hexScale: 14`, `intensity: 2`                           |
| `bubble`  | `color: '#b48cff'`, `hexIntensity: 0.2`, `rimPower: 1.5` |
| `hit`     | `hitTime: 0`, `hitPoint: [0.4, 0.3, 0.9]`                |
| `barrier` | `color: '#ff6b3d'`, `hexScale: 24`, `fill: 0.12`         |

Apply one with `forceField({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Material settings:** while patched in, the material is set to transparent, additive blending, no depth writes, both faces drawn; they are restored when it is removed.
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `effect.setMotion(false)`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 7.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/force-field`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Fresnel rim with a hexagon lattice (hexagonal cell distance after Inigo Quilez) and expanding hit ripples; Intersection highlight from a scene depth texture.
